name: hold-winners at 10->5, monthly cadence (filter-config probe)
description: Cheap probe: does the reinvestment penalty survive at the filter config Paper A likes best, on the cadence most likely to break even? Matches fresh_news_hold_winners.json exactly except filters (10-5 instead of 20-10) and freqs (12x only).
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: Paper B has only ever run ONE filter config, 20->10. Paper A's
equal-weighted results reorder the configs and put 10->5 on top:
config     Paper A model-wt   Paper A equal-wt
10->5          56.22%             66.20%   <- best once sizing is removed
20->10         60.57%             62.86%   <- the only one Paper B tested
So Paper B tested the configuration that is only SECOND best once the model's
position sizing (worth +4.1pp on GPT-5.1, p=5e-10) is taken out of the picture.
WHY 12x ONLY: across all five completed arms, 12x is the cadence where
reinvestment comes closest to breaking even against INIT (hold_winners: -1.11pp
at 12x vs -8.91pp at 2x). If reinvestment cannot beat buy-and-hold at the best
config on the best cadence, it will not do so anywhere - and this costs 27 runs
instead of 108 to find out.
9 windows x 3 runs x 1 cadence x 1 filter = 27 runs, roughly 10 minutes.
ONE VARIABLE: every option matches fresh_news_hold_winners.json. Only 'filters',
'freqs' and 'results_subdir' differ, so the contrast against the 20->10 arm at
12x (n=27, vs-INIT -1.11pp) is clean.
WHAT TO LOOK AT: vs_no_reinvest_pp for these 27 runs against hold_winners' 12x
subset. If it turns positive, filter config matters and the full 108-run grid is
worth running. If it stays negative, that is six arms in a row losing to
buy-and-hold and the filter dimension is not where the answer lives.
NOTE rebalance_mode is 'hold', NOT 'hold_redeploy', deliberately - hold_winners
used plain hold, and matching it keeps this a single-variable test. hold strands
exit proceeds on only ~5% of decisions at this framing, so the effect is small
here; it was catastrophic only under the incumbent framing.
dry_run is FALSE: this preset SPENDS BUDGET the moment it is started.
